description: The backoff delay formula uses baseDelayMs ** (attemptIndex + 3) instead of baseDelayMs * 2 ** attemptIndex, so delays explode even for small baseDelayMs. All three retry tests genuinely time out rather than failing an assertion -- this case exercises the agent's timeout-recovery path (retry with a longer timeout / isolate to the failing test file) rather than a normal patch-and-verify loop.
note: Verified with `vitest run test/retry.test.ts --testTimeout=3000`; all 3 tests time out at 3000ms. Default vitest test timeout (5000ms) will also be exceeded.
